faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Have a question? It might already be answered here. Otherwise, get in touch.

items.question: How does furniture rental work?
items.answer: Pick your items from the catalogue, set your event dates, and get an instant PDF quote. Then confirm your request on WhatsApp.

items.question: How do I know if an item is available for my date?
items.answer: On each product page, enter your start and end dates: real availability is computed live based on existing reservations for that period.

items.question: Is the quote free and non-binding?
items.answer: Yes, requesting a quote doesn't commit you to anything. It simply holds the stock for 48 hours while you confirm your order.

items.question: Do you offer delivery?
items.answer: Yes, you can choose delivery to your address or pickup at our depot when requesting a quote.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: Payment is finalized directly with our team after your quote is confirmed (Mobile Money, cash). Online payment is coming soon.

items.question: How can I track my quote request?
items.answer: Keep the reference you received after your request and use the "Track my quote" page to check its status at any time.

sections.heading: Data we collect
sections.body: When you request a quote or contact us, we collect your name, email, phone number and, if needed, your delivery address. This information is used solely to process your request.

sections.heading: How we use your data
sections.body: Your data is used to generate quotes, arrange delivery or pickup, and follow up on your reservation. We never sell your data to third parties.

sections.heading: Retention
sections.body: Your information is kept for as long as needed to manage your order and meet our accounting obligations, then deleted or anonymized.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time via the Contact page.

sections.heading: Purpose
sections.body: These terms govern the event furniture rental service offered on this site. By submitting a quote request, you accept the terms below.

sections.heading: Quotes and availability
sections.body: A quote generated on the site holds the related stock for 48 hours. Past that delay without confirmation, the reservation is automatically cancelled and the stock becomes available again.

sections.heading: Item condition
sections.body: No security deposit is required. Equipment must be returned in the condition it was delivered in; any damage or loss may still be charged.

sections.heading: Delivery and pickup
sections.body: Depending on the option chosen, furniture is delivered to the given address or picked up at our depot, within the slots proposed during the quote request.

sections.heading: Pricing
sections.body: Prices are in CFA Francs (XOF) and calculated per rental day. The total is indicative until final confirmation with our team.
